1: // Simple endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: // Targets <canvas id="game"></canvas>
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800);
8:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600);
9: 
10:   // ----- Ship -----
11:   const ship = {
12:     x: W / 2,
13:     y: H * 0.8,
14:     r: 15,
15:     angle: 0, // radians
16:     vx: 0,
17:     vy: 0,
18:     thrust: 0.1,
19:     rotateSpeed: 0.07,
20:   };
21: 
22:   // ----- Starfield -----
23:   const stars = [];
24:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
25:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H, size: Math.random() * 2 + 1 });
26:   }
27:   function updateStars() {
28:     for (const s of stars) {
29:       s.y += 1.5; // speed of forward motion
30:       if (s.y > H) {
31:         s.x = Math.random() * W;
32:         s.y = 0;
33:         s.size = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
34:       }
35:     }
36:   }
37:   function drawStars() {
38:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
39:     for (const s of stars) ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.size, s.size);
40:   }
41: 
42:   // ----- Obstacles -----
43:   const obstacles = [];
44:   const OBSTACLE_FREQ = 120; // frames
45:   let frameCount = 0;
46:   function spawnObstacle() {
47:     const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
48:     const x = Math.random() * (W - radius * 2) + radius;
49:     obstacles.push({ x, y: -radius, r: radius, speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2 });
50:   }
51:   function updateObstacles() {
52:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
53:       const o = obstacles[i];
54:       o.y += o.speed;
55:       if (o.y - o.r > H) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
56:     }
57:   }
58:   function drawObstacles() {
59:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
60:     for (const o of obstacles) {
61:       ctx.beginPath();
62:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
63:       ctx.fill();
64:     }
65:   }
66: 
67:   // ----- Input -----
68:   const keys = {};
69:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
70:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
71: 
72:   // ----- Game state -----
73:   let running = true;
74:   let score = 0;
75: 
76:   function reset() {
77:     ship.x = W / 2;
78:     ship.y = H * 0.8;
79:     ship.vx = ship.vy = 0;
80:     ship.angle = 0;
81:     obstacles.length = 0;
82:     frameCount = 0;
83:     score = 0;
84:     running = true;
85:   }
86: 
87:   function checkCollision() {
88:     for (const o of obstacles) {
89:       const dx = ship.x - o.x;
90:       const dy = ship.y - o.y;
91:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
92:       if (dist < ship.r + o.r) return true;
93:     }
94:     return false;
95:   }
96: 
97:   function updateShip() {
98:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.angle -= ship.rotateSpeed;
99:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.angle += ship.rotateSpeed;
100:     if (keys.ArrowUp) {
101:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
102:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
103:     }
104:     // apply velocity
105:     ship.x += ship.vx;
106:     ship.y += ship.vy;
107:     // simple friction
108:     ship.vx *= 0.99;
109:     ship.vy *= 0.99;
110:     // keep inside canvas
111:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x = W;
112:     if (ship.x > W) ship.x = 0;
113:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y = H;
114:     if (ship.y > H) ship.y = 0;
115:   }
116:   function drawShip() {
117:     ctx.save();
118:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
119:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
120:     ctx.fillStyle = 'lime';
121:     ctx.beginPath();
122:     ctx.moveTo(0, -ship.r);
123:     ctx.lineTo(ship.r * 0.6, ship.r);
124:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r * 0.6, ship.r);
125:     ctx.closePath();
126:     ctx.fill();
127:     ctx.restore();
128:   }
129: 
130:   function loop() {
131:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
132:     updateStars();
133:     drawStars();
134:     if (running) {
135:       if (frameCount % OBSTACLE_FREQ === 0) spawnObstacle();
136:       updateObstacles();
137:       drawObstacles();
138:       updateShip();
139:       drawShip();
140:       if (checkCollision()) running = false;
141:       score++;
142:     } else {
143:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
144:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
145:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
146:       ctx.fillText('Game Over – Score: ' + score, W / 2, H / 2);
147:       ctx.fillText('Press Space to Restart', W / 2, H / 2 + 30);
148:       if (keys[' ']) reset();
149:     }
150:     frameCount++;
151:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
152:   }
153: 
154:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
155: })();

(End of file - total 155 lines)
